headline: On last trading day, Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 led by banking stocks.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Banking stocks and foreign inflows lifted the benchmark indices during the last session.
Nifty Bank scaled a record high as Sensex jumped 898 points, defying a global sell-off.
Markets recovered strongly after initially opening lower due to a global sell-off in AI stocks.
Strong core sector data showing 10.9% growth in October aided broader market sentiment.
whatHappening: NIFTY50 ended at 25,801 while SENSEX surged 898 points on the last trading day.
IndusInd Bank invoked clawback provisions against former executive Kathpalia from 2020.
India's core sector growth accelerated to a 31-month high of 10.9% in October.
India's forex reserves dropped by $14.2 billion to stand at $705.34 billion.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian markets rallied sharply with Sensex jumping 898 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800.
Banking stocks led the market surge, driving Nifty Bank to a new record high despite earlier global AI tech sell-off concerns.
Key domestic macroeconomic updates included core sector growth reaching a 31-month high of 10.9% in October and forex reserves dropping to $705.34 billion.
